title: REQ · Admin round service adapts round.Service with consistent types and errors
summary: An adapter makes round.Service satisfy admin.RoundService
description: Context: admin.RoundService returns world.Round and uses admin.ErrNotFound/ErrConflict/ErrInvalid; round.Service returns round.Round and round.ErrNotFound/ErrIllegalTransition/ErrActiveRound. Desired: one adapter in internal/server converts round.Round to world.Round and maps errors. Expected: handlers return correct statuses.
acceptance_criteria: Given a round.Round with status OPEN, when converted, then world.Round has the same ID, Number, StartsAt, EndsAt and Status string OPEN
Given round.ErrNotFound, round.ErrIllegalTransition or round.ErrActiveRound, when the adapter returns it, then errors.Is matches admin.ErrNotFound, admin.ErrConflict, admin.ErrConflict respectively
